title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Eligibility and Term Schedule
content:
Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts are sold at six coverage levels. This schedule sets, level by level, which vehicles a contract may be sold on, the terms that may be sold, the point the term counts from and the highest price.

| Coverage level | Vehicle conditions | Greatest vehicle age at sale (years) | Greatest odometer at sale (miles) | Term months that may be sold | Term miles that may be sold | Term counts from | Highest price (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Shield Powertrain | used | 12 | 150000 | 24, 36, 48 | 24000, 36000, 48000 | sale date and odometer at sale | 2195.00 |
| Kessler Shield Powertrain Plus | used, certified pre-owned | 12 | 130000 | 24, 36, 48, 60 | 36000, 48000, 60000 | sale date and odometer at sale | 2695.00 |
| Kessler Shield Select | used, certified pre-owned, new | 10 | 120000 | 36, 48, 60 | 36000, 48000, 60000, 75000 | sale date and odometer at sale | 3295.00 |
| Kessler Shield Preferred | used, certified pre-owned, new | 8 | 100000 | 36, 48, 60, 72 | 48000, 60000, 75000, 100000 | sale date and odometer at sale | 3795.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary | used, certified pre-owned, new | 6 | 80000 | 36, 48, 60, 72 | 48000, 60000, 75000, 100000 | sale date and odometer at sale | 4495.00 |
| Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap | new | 1 | 12000 | 72, 84 | 75000, 100000 | the vehicle's in-service date, at odometer 0 | 3495.00 |

**Commercial use.** No coverage level may cover a vehicle in commercial use.

**Who may hold each level.** The first five levels are sold to individual customers on a vehicle in personal use whose condition is listed for the level. The Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap is sold to an individual customer on a new vehicle whose factory basic warranty is in force.

**Reading the age column.** Vehicle age at sale is the sale year less the model year. A vehicle exactly at the level's greatest age or greatest odometer is within the limit; one year or one mile beyond is not.

**Reading the term columns.** A term is one listed month figure combined with one listed mile figure. For the Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap, time and miles count from the vehicle's in-service date and odometer 0, not from the sale. For every other level they count from the sale date and the odometer at sale.

**Example (hypothetical).** A model-year vehicle sold eight years after its model year with a hypothetical 99500 miles may take Kessler Shield Preferred, whose limits are 8 years and 100000 miles. At nine years of age it may not.
